MIND. [1] [Nat. c.]
Inability to think or to perform any mental labor ; head feels stupefied if he tries to exert himself.
Sadness ; depression of spirits ; hypochondriacal mood.
Intolerable melancholy and apprehension ; she is wholly occupied with sad thoughts.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Nat. c.]
Headache from slightest mental exertion.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Nat. c.]
Much nasal mucus passes through mouth.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Nat. c.]
Pale face with blue rings around eyes, swollen eyelids.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Nat. c.]
Accumulation of mucus in throat and posterior nares.
Violent hawking up of thick mucus that constantly collects.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Nat. c.]
Aversion to milk and diarrhœa from it.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Nat. c.]
After milk, diarrhœa.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Nat. c.]
Burning in urethra during and after micturition.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Nat. c.]
Easy dislocation and spraining of ankle ; ankle is so weak that it gives way ; foot bends under.
Cold feet.
   

SKIN. [46] [Nat. c.]
Vesicles, with shooting pains and itching.
